Shouldn't this be moved to epan along with `packet_range.h`?

Hm, yes, but @guyharris moved it in e52c95c6c8cdac34eccdba9b49d68a6982685f1a and probably that should be reverted then as well.
The problem is that `file.h` includes `packet_range.h` and `file.h` is part of the public API.

My fix here for some missing, but referenced headers is shipping the referenced ones, too, but it would be even better to go through the shipped headers and think about each declaration if it should be exposed.
There are some function declarations for example which are not exported from our libraries next to structure definitions which probably should stay part of the API.

Sadly I can't pick up this task because I'm not that familiar with the current API direction to make good judgement calls in the area.

I've fixed the clear cases in the headers, but there are still some issues preventing this improved check from passing.
When the remaining header issues are solved and this passes feel free to merge it.

changes_data.diff:
@@ -81,10 +81,21 @@ else
 endif
 	rm -rf $(CURDIR)/debian/tmp/usr/share/wireshark/COPYING
 
+HEADER_CHECK_FLAGS = $(shell pkg-config --cflags glib-2.0) \
+	$(shell dpkg-buildflags --get CPPFLAGS) \
+	$(shell dpkg-buildflags --get CFLAGS) \
+	-Idebian/libwireshark-dev/usr/include \
+	-Idebian/libwireshark-dev/usr/include/wireshark \
+	-Idebian/libwireshark-dev/usr/include/libwireshark-dev/epan/dissectors \
+	-Idebian/libwiretap-dev/usr/include/wireshark \
+	-Idebian/libwsutil-dev/usr/include/wireshark \
+
 override_dh_install:
 	dh_install
-	# check all necessary headers are included
-	$(CC) -c debian/headers-check.c $(shell pkg-config --cflags glib-2.0) $(shell dpkg-buildflags --get CPPFLAGS) $(shell dpkg-buildflags --get CFLAGS) -Idebian/libwireshark-dev/usr/include -Idebian/libwireshark-dev/usr/include/wireshark -Idebian/libwiretap-dev/usr/include/wireshark -Idebian/libwsutil-dev/usr/include/wireshark -o /dev/null
+	# check that all headers can be preprocessed
+	find debian/*-dev/usr/include -type f | sed 's|.*/include/wireshark/|#include <|;s|$$|>|' | $(CC) -E - $(HEADER_CHECK_FLAGS) -o /dev/null
+	# check than #include-ing the most widely used headers compiles
+	$(CC) -c debian/headers-check.c $(HEADER_CHECK_FLAGS) -o /dev/null
 
 override_dh_fixperms:
 	dh_fixperms
